# Public API certificate expired causing TLS failures

All external clients suddenly fail to call the public API; browsers show a security warning.

The API's TLS certificate auto-renewal (cert-manager) had been silently failing for weeks due to a broken ACME HTTP-01 challenge, and no one noticed until the cert expired.

1. Confirm the expired certificate via openssl and the handshake alert
2. Issue a new certificate manually to restore service immediately
3. Fix the ACME HTTP-01 challenge routing so auto-renewal works
4. Add a certificate-expiry alert at 21 days remaining

Error Details
```
SSL certificate problem: certificate has expired; TLS handshake failed: alert certificate_expired (45); openssl: notAfter=Jul 4 2026 GMT
```

Tags: security, certificate-expiry, tls-handshake, cert-manager, acme
